note: The dispatchable expert team: one role per question, with the default model route a lab should use. Routes are advisory defaults read from the configured subagent routes; a lab may override one, but a dispatch never widens the owner's compute caps or the D23/D24 rules. Read with `python3 scripts/harness/cli.py team roster`; record a dispatch with `team dispatch`.

architecture-reviewer.title: Architecture reviewer
architecture-reviewer.purpose: Does this proposed change fit the native geometric architecture, or does it smuggle in a dense transformer, a CPU fallback or a softmax by another name?
when: does this fit the native path

experiment-designer.title: Experiment designer
experiment-designer.purpose: What is the smallest decisive run that could move this milestone's headline, and what are its bar, split, seeds and stop rule?

test-methodologist.title: Test methodologist
test-methodologist.purpose: Could this pre-registered test as written actually judge the mechanism it names, or is it underpowered, bolted on, or circular?

systems-cost.title: Systems and cost
systems-cost.purpose: Is this run admissible at all — right machine, within the owner caps, on the cumulative ledger, and clear of the disk floor?

evidence-auditor.title: Evidence auditor
evidence-auditor.purpose: Is the delivered record complete and honest — exact artifact identities, scoped numbers, preserved negatives and a Next that follows?

source-falsifier.title: Source falsifier
source-falsifier.purpose: What in the actual source contradicts this claim, and what is the smallest reproduction that would falsify it?
when: does the source really do this

instrumenter.title: Instrumenter and implementer
instrumenter.purpose: Build the named instrument, kernel or fixture at this path, with its focused test, without changing the contract it serves.

delivery-reviewer.title: Delivery reviewer
delivery-reviewer.purpose: Is this exactly the PR described — line, count, headline, exact-head checks, record and current-state entry — and is anything in it stale or silently widened?

history-curator.title: History curator
history-curator.purpose: Has this configuration already been tested, kept or rejected, and what is the D21 count and the earlier lesson that applies here?
